summary: Updates the staging-delivery workflow guidance for the protected pre-launch mode that keeps only the latest healthy release routed in staging.

instructions: Reinstall enterpriseglue-dev-workflows 0.1.13 from the repository marketplace and start a new Codex task so the updated staging guidance is loaded.

configuration: STAGING_SINGLE_RELEASE_MODE remains a protected, default-off EnterpriseGlue Cloud staging environment variable; it is not an OSS runtime setting.
security: The guidance retains signed artifact, exact-reference, readiness, mutation-lock, route, and zero-reference checks and does not alter production policy.
documentation: The staging-delivery skill now distinguishes normal multi-release policy from protected pre-launch single-release staging operation.
knownLimitations: Reinstalling the plugin does not change a running Codex task; start a new task to load version 0.1.13.
rollback: Reinstall plugin version 0.1.12 to restore the prior guidance; this does not change Cloud staging state.
validation: The repository plugin contract, official skill and plugin validators, release-note preflight, and documentation boundary guard pass locally.
